controlName: AI Systems Are Evaluated for Trustworthy Characteristics
purpose: Ensures the AI system is tested for the full range of trustworthy AI characteristics — validity, safety, security, fairness, privacy — not just accuracy on a benchmark dataset.
summary: AI systems are evaluated for trustworthy characteristics, including validity and reliability, safety, security and resilience, and other dimensions such as privacy and fairness, using documented test methodologies and evaluations conducted under real deployment conditions with ongoing production monitoring.
expectedStatementElements: What test, evaluation, verification, and validation (TEVV) methodologies and tools are used and documented
How the system is evaluated for safety, including failure modes and misuse scenarios
How the system is evaluated for security and resilience, including adversarial testing
How performance is evaluated under actual deployment conditions rather than only synthetic testing
What ongoing production monitoring exists after deployment
evidenceExamples: Safety evaluation results identifying failure modes and misuse scenarios
Production monitoring dashboard or reports showing ongoing performance tracking
commonGaps: Testing only occurred once before launch, with no evaluation under real deployment conditions
No adversarial or security testing has been performed
Safety evaluation didn't consider realistic misuse scenarios
No production monitoring exists to catch degradation after deployment
interviewQuestions: What testing methodology was used to evaluate this system, and is it documented?
Has this system been evaluated under real deployment conditions, not just in a test environment?
Has any adversarial or security testing been performed against this system?
What monitoring is in place to catch problems after the system is already live?
